messages.text: How do changes in AI data centers technology affect the measurement capability required from Signaling / Non-signaling Tester?

### Short answer
The passages do not directly state that AI data center technology changes change the required measurement capability of a Signaling / Non-signaling Tester such as R&S CMX500 or R&S CMP180; the supported answer is that AI data center changes point to more high-speed digital, PCB, interconnect, power, and cooling measurement needs, while the cited Signaling / Non-signaling Testers are documented for cellular/WLAN device RF, signaling, throughput, application, and production non-signaling RF testing rather than AI data center infrastructure testing [1][11][22][71].
### Supported details
AI data center infrastructure is described as combining high-speed electrical interconnect, optical interconnect, fiber deployment, rack power distribution, busbar, liquid cooling, and leak detection, so the technology change is broader than wireless RF alone [11].  
AI server PCB upgrades are described as moving toward higher layer count, larger area, and high-speed transmission, with materials moving to low-Dk, low-loss, high-thermal designs, and process challenges such as 30–40 layer mainboards, 12–14 aspect ratio, thick copper, and laser drilling [22][24].  
The directly supported measurement needs for PCB / high-speed digital work are impedance by TDR, DK/DF extraction, insertion loss, roughness, crosstalk, transmission-line modeling, eye diagram, signal-integrity modeling/testing, sampling testing, and process monitoring [16][85].  
For AI data center connectivity, the cited passages mention high-speed electrical links such as 224 Gb/s PAM4 mezzanine connectors, 448G connector solutions, OSFP cable assemblies up to 224G/lane PAM4 and 1.6T aggregate bandwidth, plus optical, power, and cooling connectivity claims [73][74][75].  
For Signaling Tester scope, R&S CMX500 is documented as a universal one-box network emulation and measurement solution for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, TDD, WLAN signaling, WLAN TX measurements, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput, PER, application tests, IP traffic analysis, IMS/audio/POLQA, XLAPI, and SCPI remote control [1][2].  
For Non-signaling Tester scope, R&S CMP180 is documented in the WLAN production phase, where RF measurements are executed in non-signaling mode to save time, with support for Wi‑Fi 6E, Wi‑Fi 7, 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz, bandwidths up to 500 MHz, 2x2 MIMO in one box, and scalable 4x4 MIMO access point testing using two instruments [71].  
【推論】Therefore, if the question is about AI data center infrastructure itself, the measurement capability gap suggested by the passages is not more cellular/WLAN signaling capability, but more PCB / high-speed digital / SI capability such as TDR impedance, DK/DF, insertion loss, crosstalk, eye diagram, and process monitoring [11][16][22][85].  
【推論】If the Signaling / Non-signaling Tester is used for wireless devices that coexist with or connect around data center environments, the cited tester capability remains cellular/WLAN RF, signaling, throughput, application, and production RF testing, but the passages do not prove a direct AI data center-driven new option or specification requirement for CMX500 or CMP180 [1][2][71].

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500 › Application tests 與 audio
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

- 未啟用 R&S CMX-KA100 等 application test license 時，IP application test functionality 降到最低；只能使用 standalone mode，不能連接 external servers，也不支援 IP based measurements 或 tools。
- R&S CMX-KA100 提供 internal IP services 與 IP connection to DUT 測試 applications，包含 DNS、IMS、Message Center、FTP、HTTP、DNS monitor、IP logging、iPerf、Ping、throughput、Max Throughput Wizard、web server。
- R&S CMX-KA110 增強 KA100，加入 QoS、ePDG、N3IWF、delay measurement、IP tune tool、SMPP / MT SMS advanced settings。
- R&S CMX-KA150 提供 IP analysis tool，用於監控與分析 DUT uplink / downlink IP traffic。
- R&S CMX-KA180 提供 audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice call，支援 AMR-NB、AMR-WB、EVS，並包含 [[R&S CMX-ZG180A]] external sound card drivers and configuration settings。
- R&S CMX-KA181 加入 [[POLQA]]，用於 measuring perceived speech quality；measurement version 為 3，mode 為 full-band 或 narrowband。
- R&S CMX-KA401 支援 WAV player / recorder、upload/download WAV files、file-based POLQA measurements 與 end-to-end audio delay。

R&S CMX500 › 規格與數字的使用限制
- [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 是正式 Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025）；引用數字時仍需保留原文條件，例如溫度、warm-up、level alignment、overrange、EVM waveform、SCS、modulation、channel bandwidth、port、RMS / PEP、typ. / meas. / nom.。
- [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] 是 Features and Functions overview；其中沒有 tolerance limits 的 data 不具 binding。
- 不能從 [[R&S CMX-B500x]]、[[R&S CMX-B600x]]、`.xx` 後綴或其他命名規則推導完整料號；完整 order number 只能抄自來源或正式 configure / ordering data。
- [[R&S CMX-RF42E]] 的更多資料在另一份 PD 3609.7719.22 specifications；本頁不得補推該文件版次、日期或額外規格。
- 報價與組態相容性需交由正式 configure 工具確認；wiki 只忠實記錄來源文字。

CMX500 Callbox › Callbox 定位
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]，callbox 的核心敘事是：

- Easy to set up。
- Easy to get in a call。
- Easy to test with。
- Focus on [[RF Testing]]，including [[3GPP pre-conformance]]。

來源以 [[Device Under Test]]、cell tower 與 smartphone 圖示描述 [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 DUT 連線與測試環境的中心。

CMX500 Callbox
[[CMX500 Callbox]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 簡報中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 use-case 定位：用一台 callbox 快速建立 DUT 連線，進行 RF、mobility、application、NTN、WLAN / cellular desense、pre-conformance 與 non-signaling R&D 驗證。

CMX500 Callbox › Example Callbox use cases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 的 Example Callbox use cases 進一步列出：

- R&D verification of new bands。
- Sensitivity testing。
- [[RedCap]]。
- [[CMX500 Desense Testing]]。
- [[3GPP Pre-Conformance Testing]]。
- [[CMX500 SRS RF measurements]]。
- UL MIMO and UL CA RF measurements。
- UL TX Switching。
- [[CMX500 Multi-SIM testing]]。
- High e2e TP testing。
- Non-signaling verification。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › R&D：R&S CMX500 single-box signaling testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing
[[Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 中描述的測試方案組合：以 [[R&S CMX500]] 覆蓋 R&D signaling / interworking 測試，以 [[R&S CMP180]] 覆蓋 production non-signaling RF 測試。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Wi-Fi 7 技術挑戰
來源將 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] 描述為 designed for extremely high data throughput，面向 tens of gigabits per second、low latency、ultra-high-definition video streaming、virtual reality 與 augmented reality applications。來源列出的 higher throughput key elements：

| 技術項目 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| channel bandwidth | increased channel bandwidth of 320 MHz |
| spatial streams | up to 16 spatial streams |
| modulation | 4096 QAM modulation |
| MLO | key feature；使 multiple RF chains 測試環境變重要 |

Data center full-spectrum connectivity › 與既有概念的關係
- [[Data center server 高速互連產品組合]] 偏向 data center server interconnect portfolio 的分類表；[[Data center full-spectrum connectivity]] 更強調 full-spectrum：electrical interconnect + optical + fiber + power + cooling。
- [[Compute tray component solutions]] 偏向 compute tray connectors、cables、power connector、busbar 與 backplane interconnect；本頁納入 optical transceiver、CPO、fiber deployment 與 liquid cooling。
- [[高速伺服器儲存互連]] 可連接本頁中的 [[Mini Cool Edge IO]]、[[Cool Express Link]]、[[Direct Attached Copper Cables]]、[[PCIe CEM 7 Connectors]] 與 storage / EDSFF 類產品。
- [[CPO]]、[[Optical I-O]]、[[Near-Packaged Optics]] 可連接本頁的 [[Amphenol Co-packaged Optics]] 與 [[LEAP On-Board Transceiver]]，但本來源不是技術標準或市場採用證據。

Data center full-spectrum connectivity
[[Data center full-spectrum connectivity]] 是 [[full-spectrum-data-center-connectivity-brochure]] 呈現的 portfolio 視角：把 AI / data center 的 high-speed electrical interconnect、optical interconnect、fiber deployment、rack power distribution、busbar、liquid cooling 與 leak detection 放在同一張 data center connectivity brochure 中。

Virtual Signalling Tester › 來源定義
[[mx844030pc-j1200]] 將 [[Virtual Signalling Tester]] 描述為 software protocol simulator / Virtual Signalling Test Solution，透過虛擬化 protocol stack，在 PC 上重現多個 protocol layers：

- [[RRC-NAS]]
- [[PDCP]]
- [[RLC]]
- [[MAC]]

來源主張它可不使用一般硬體測試儀而在 PC 上快速建立 protocol test environment；但 RF-IF configuration 仍使用 [[Anritsu MD8190A]] Universal RF Unit 與 [[MX819020A]] RF Platform。

Virtual Signalling Tester › Pre-silicon testing
- 對 chipset development 的 [[Shift-Left]] 有效。
- 在實體 chipset 製造前，用 virtual terminal 執行 protocol test。
- 用於早期發現問題、降低 rework、提高 development efficiency。
- 來源圖中列出 SW Simulation、EDA Emulation、FPGA Prototype、Chipset Integration / Regression。

Virtual Signalling Tester › Post-silicon testing
- 適用 [[IoT]] device 與 communication module 的 basic protocol test。
- 支援快速 functional test、regression test、sample scenario parameterization、test procedure 與 report / log display。
- 來源列出 [[5G RedCap]]、Automotive、Healthcare、Industrial IoT、Smart Cities 等應用語境。

R&S ZNA › Measurement speed
- Measurement speed 測試條件：firmware version 3.20、Windows 11 (64 bit)。
- Acquisition time per point：1 MHz measurement bandwidth、IF filter analog wideband 時 1 µs；30 MHz measurement bandwidth 時 32 ns。
- Linear frequency sweep 條件 201 points、10 GHz center frequency、200 MHz span：1 MHz measurement bandwidth、IF filter analog normal 時 time per sweep < 3.9 ms；sweep cycle time < 4.9 ms。
- IEC/IEEE VXI11 over 1 Gbit/s LAN：201 measurement points、800 MHz start frequency、1 GHz stop frequency、1 MHz measurement bandwidth 的 measurement and data transfer time 為 14 ms / 13 ms；201 measurement points magnitude 的 data transfer time 為 1.7 ms / 0.9 ms。
- Switching time between channels with a maximum of 2001 points：< 2 ms。
- Continuous mode 不需要額外 data transfer time，因為 data transfer 與 measurement 同時進行。

R&S ZNA › Key performance（Version 24.00）
- Dynamic range：> 129 dB specification without options；147 dB typical with options；maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction。
- Sensitivity：> –120 dBm，1 Hz IF bandwidth，specification without options；–162 dBm，1 Hz IF bandwidth，measured with options。來源註明 –162 dBm 是以 1 kHz measurement bandwidth 量測後 normalized to 1 Hz。
- Power sweep range：100 dB typical continuous electronic sweep range；可使用 mechanical step attenuators 位移 sweep range。
- Source power linearity：0.2 dB typical，範圍 –40 dBm to +10 dBm。
- Receiver compression：0.05 dB typical，up to +8 dBm at test port，referenced to –10 dBm。
- Trace noise：0.005 dB specification RMS、0.002 dB typical RMS，條件為 10 GHz、100 kHz measurement bandwidth、0 dB reflection。
- Speed example：10 MHz to 43.5 GHz、500 kHz measurement bandwidth、1601 points、2-port calibration 時 sweep time 96 ms nominal。

- [[Amphenol XtremePass]] — 來源稱 XtremePass 448G connector solution 提供 best-in-class SI performance、maximize substrate density，支援 32DP 到 128DP form factors，並跨 Ethernet、NVLink、PCIe 與 InfiniBand systems。

- [[Amphenol Co-packaged Optics]] — 來源稱 Amphenol CPO extends end-to-end ownership to the chip，從 high-density electrical interposer 到 optical conversion module 再到 fiber plant。
- [[BarKlip Busbar Connectors]] — 來源補充 BarKlip I/O products 用於 busbars、cables 與 circuit boards 間 high-current power distribution，且 direct pluggable connection to an uninsulated busbar generates very low energy loss。

OCP Accelerator Module (OAM) › 為什麼不是 PCIe AIC / PCIe CEM
[[OCP Accelerator Module OAM Specifications]]（來源未標示正式發布日期；Rev 0.85 context）指出 [[PCIe CEM]] / [[PCIe AIC]] form factor 對 [[HPC]] accelerator system 的限制包含：

- multi cards in system；
- high interconnect bandwidth needed between card to card；
- too much signal loss from ASIC to high-speed connectors in PCIe form factor；
- inter-card cabling difficult and limited in supported topologies。

PI for Digital Power › 與既有知識的關係

R&S CMX500 › mmWave extension 與 remote radio heads
[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 指出 3GPP FR2 frequency range 測試可由 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]]、[[R&S CMXHEAD50]] 或 [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]] 執行。Remote radio head 是獨立 compact unit，在 IF 與 5G NR FR2 frequency ranges 間執行 upconversion / downconversion。CMX500 與 remote radio head 的 split concept 可在 5G NR FR2 frequency range 使用短 RF cable lengths，以最佳化 radiated chamber test environments 的 link budget。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Production：R&S CMP180 non-signaling RF testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- WLAN device production phase 中，所有 RF measurements 以 non-signaling mode 執行以節省時間。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被定位為 optimized for this purpose 的 radio communication tester。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] 支援 many cellular and non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。

- 來源稱 480 MHz WLAN waveform 是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate；這不是正式 Wi‑Fi 8 規格。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] integrated two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing。

- [[WLAN offloading]] 是把原本 intended for cellular networks 的 data 透過 WLAN 傳送，以減少 cellular bands data load。
- [[Voice over WLAN]] 情境聚焦在 cellular network 與 WLAN 之間 handover during a voice call，以維持 uninterrupted voice call experience。

### Short answer
The passages do not directly state that AI data center technology changes change the required measurement capability of a Signaling / Non-signaling Tester such as R&S CMX500 or R&S CMP180; the supported answer is that AI data center changes point to more high-speed digital, PCB, interconnect, power, and cooling measurement needs, while the cited Signaling / Non-signaling Testers are documented for cellular/WLAN device RF, signaling, throughput, application, and production non-signaling RF testing rather than AI data center infrastructure testing [1][11][22][71].
### Supported details
AI data center infrastructure is described as combining high-speed electrical interconnect, optical interconnect, fiber deployment, rack power distribution, busbar, liquid cooling, and leak detection, so the technology change is broader than wireless RF alone [11].  
AI server PCB upgrades are described as moving toward higher layer count, larger area, and high-speed transmission, with materials moving to low-Dk, low-loss, high-thermal designs, and process challenges such as 30–40 layer mainboards, 12–14 aspect ratio, thick copper, and laser drilling [22][24].  
The directly supported measurement needs for PCB / high-speed digital work are impedance by TDR, DK/DF extraction, insertion loss, roughness, crosstalk, transmission-line modeling, eye diagram, signal-integrity modeling/testing, sampling testing, and process monitoring [16][85].  
For AI data center connectivity, the cited passages mention high-speed electrical links such as 224 Gb/s PAM4 mezzanine connectors, 448G connector solutions, OSFP cable assemblies up to 224G/lane PAM4 and 1.6T aggregate bandwidth, plus optical, power, and cooling connectivity claims [73][74][75].  
For Signaling Tester scope, R&S CMX500 is documented as a universal one-box network emulation and measurement solution for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, TDD, WLAN signaling, WLAN TX measurements, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput, PER, application tests, IP traffic analysis, IMS/audio/POLQA, XLAPI, and SCPI remote control [1][2].  
For Non-signaling Tester scope, R&S CMP180 is documented in the WLAN production phase, where RF measurements are executed in non-signaling mode to save time, with support for Wi‑Fi 6E, Wi‑Fi 7, 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz, bandwidths up to 500 MHz, 2x2 MIMO in one box, and scalable 4x4 MIMO access point testing using two instruments [71].  
【推論】Therefore, if the question is about AI data center infrastructure itself, the measurement capability gap suggested by the passages is not more cellular/WLAN signaling capability, but more PCB / high-speed digital / SI capability such as TDR impedance, DK/DF, insertion loss, crosstalk, eye diagram, and process monitoring [11][16][22][85].  
【推論】If the Signaling / Non-signaling Tester is used for wireless devices that coexist with or connect around data center environments, the cited tester capability remains cellular/WLAN RF, signaling, throughput, application, and production RF testing, but the passages do not prove a direct AI data center-driven new option or specification requirement for CMX500 or CMP180 [1][2][71].

- [[R&S CMP180]] 被定位為 optimized for this purpose 的 radio communication tester。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] 支援 many cellular and non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform。
- 來源稱 480 MHz WLAN waveform 是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate；這不是正式 Wi‑Fi 8 規格。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] integrated two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing。
- 來源稱 two [[R&S CMP180]] instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for efficient testing of 4x4 [[MIMO]] access points。
